verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents some of the pieces this story needs. Its pricing lists a code editor alongside the drag-and-drop editor, and its OpenAPI spec includes a Design Studio API. The CLI claims full workspace access via `cio api`, and the transactional API accepts data that populates message content, which gives variable substitution. However, the evidence never shows template create/update endpoints, raw HTML or MJML authoring workflows, or any git/version-control integration, so templates-as-code is only implied. Missing for 10: documented template CRUD API, MJML/HTML-as-code workflow, version-control or sync-from-repo support, explicit templating/variable syntax docs, hands-on corroboration.
